quickPrompts.label: Give me Alex's 30-second intro
responses:
Alex is an Automation Engineer with a strong business analysis background.
He analyses raw technical data and business processes, genuinely enjoys identifying bottlenecks, and turns them into clear automation solutions with well-defined acceptance criteria.
He has a strong understanding of the challenges, limitations and practical realities of modern tools, from Excel dependencies to AI hype.
He prefers a S.M.A.R.T. approach to task-setting and follows the Kaizen philosophy: improvement is not a one-off task, but a continuous process guided by clearly defined metrics.

Would you like to see details about his latest work experience?

Alex is an Automation Engineer with a strong understanding of end-to-end workflows.
He understands both the technical side of automation and the business context: how processes work, how roles are distributed, where bottlenecks appear, and what limitations exist in ERP systems, AI tools and API integrations.
His focus is not simply to implement IT solutions, but to improve operational processes and demonstrate business impact through clear metrics.

Would you like to see details about his latest work experience?

Alex is an Automation Engineer who helps companies improve operational processes through analysis, automation and measurable outcomes.
He is able to take a process from analysis through to the implementation of an automation solution, followed by quality control and documentation. Alex works with Python, Excel-to-ERP migration, API integrations, internal tools and AI-assisted automation.
In his work, he prefers a S.M.A.R.T. approach.

Would you like to see an example from his most recent work experience?

disclaimer.title: Website, AI assistant, and monitoring disclaimer
disclaimer.bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

This website and its AI assistant are provided for informational and portfolio demonstration purposes. They are not a guarantee of availability, professional certification, legal advice, immigration advice, financial advice, medical advice, or any other regulated professional advice.

## AI assistant limitations

The assistant is designed to answer questions from reviewed public professional context. It can be incomplete or wrong. If it does not have enough information, it should say so and suggest direct contact instead of inventing facts.

## Do not submit sensitive information

Do not submit passwords, API keys, payment details, private tokens, medical information, legal case details, home addresses, confidential employer/client data, or personal data about other people through the chat, contact form, or handoff flow.

## Human handoff

If a visitor confirms human handoff, relevant chat context may be sent to the website owner through Telegram so the owner can reply. Do not start handoff with sensitive third-party personal data or confidential business information.

## Analytics and monitoring

The project uses operational metrics and privacy-safe aggregate product metrics. These metrics are intended to monitor reliability and broad usage signals. They are not intended to profile individual visitors.

The project intentionally avoids visitor IDs, user IDs, analytics cookies, localStorage tracking IDs, IP hashes, User-Agent hashes, raw referrers, query strings, and per-user chat usage metrics.

## Reuse

The codebase may be reused according to its license, but personal profile content, resume content, SEO metadata, screenshots, public CV files, video IDs, and RAG knowledge examples should be replaced before reuse for another person or organisation.
